subject: french
title: Language and Self
welcome_lead: Language shapes identity. Speaking a second language opens new selves — and reveals first ones.
meta_desc: French: language as identity and the multilingual self.
final_note: Each language you speak is another room of yourself.

concepts.def: Dialect — regional variety of a language.

walkthroughs.body_html: Phrases: Le bilinguisme enrichit la pensee. For comparison: contrairement au monolinguisme. Cite research informally: les chercheurs ont demontre que.
Talk about l'accent quebecois vs l'accent parisien. Note: chaque accent porte une histoire.
For the oral, prepare to describe a photo about language identity. Use sur la photo, on voit. and link to wider themes: cette image illustre la richesse du plurilinguisme.

mcqs.q: What is the most common informal way to form a yes/no question in French?
options: Rising intonation (statement said as a question) or using 'est-ce que'.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I'm going to my friend's house' in French?
options: Je vais à la maison de mon ami.

mcqs.q: How do you say 'I am using my phone right now' (emphasising the action is in progress)?
options: Je suis en train d'utiliser mon portable.
